description: Native CAD mutations lack a shared revision-freeze gate
root_cause: Desktop auto_route_pcb, schematic edits, slot/plane operations and render-on-read reach adapters directly.
evidence: boundary-results.json: archived adapter called; non-mutating spy kept bytes unchanged.
impact: Archived design/evidence can be edited; historical review context can silently diverge.
fix: Move mutation authorization into the shared service: draft-only, expected revision/spec/artifact hash, copy-on-write and recorded operation receipts. Make previews read-only caches outside baselines.
acceptance: For every mutator, archived/conflicting requests fail before adapter invocation; hash every baseline before/after; exercise retries and concurrent revision changes.

description: Generated electrical representations are not equivalent
root_cause: Symbol-pin coordinates, labels and native ASC wiring do not preserve the simulated graph.
evidence: erc.json: 20 errors and 18 warnings; native-asc-netlisting.json: NC_01..NC_08 and no PWM drive. Direct SPICE buck still runs.
impact: Simulation success does not validate the editable circuit delivered to the engineer.
fix: Correct one canonical buck graph through KiCad and ASC; independently netlist both and compare connections/pin roles to IR. Resolve all ERC errors and dangling/off-grid wiring.
acceptance: Native KiCad and LTspice netlists match the selected IR; positive/negative fixtures detect omitted gate/load paths; the delivered schematic reproduces the reference simulation.

description: Manufacturing export bypasses verification
root_cause: Desktop export_gerbers passes force=True, which bypasses the lower-level DRC/routing gate.
evidence: desktop/service.py export_gerbers and lifecycle/kicad_service.py force branch; raw native exports succeeded despite two board errors.
impact: A downloadable fabrication ZIP can be mistaken for a reviewed package.
fix: Remove hidden force bypass; distinguish unqualified draft exports from fabrication candidates and carry explicit ERC/DRC/integrity blockers. Do not implement manufacturing approval.
acceptance: Known failing/unrouted boards cannot be presented as fabrication-ready; explicit draft export is labeled and preserves its issue reports and revision digest.

description: Engineering dossiers manufacture positive verdicts
root_cause: ERC reader ignores nested sheets; FEMM renderer fills missing evidence and uses a fixed PASS margin.
evidence: real-erc-dossier-card.html says Clean with native 20 errors; empty-femm-dossier-card.html says PASS (99.3% Margin) from {}.
impact: Readers receive false engineering assurance even when the underlying raw evidence is absent or failing.
fix: Use canonical strict parsers and effective evidence status; reject incomplete records; compute displayed margins from qualified inputs; never infer passing from missing keys.
acceptance: Feed nested ERC errors, malformed JSON, missing excitation, stale hashes and an explicit failure; UI/HTML/PDF/snapshot all retain FAIL or NOT_EVALUATED, never PASS.

description: BOM parts and simulation models are not qualified selections
root_cause: Generated IR and the small sourced reference library do not establish exact model, footprint, temperature and SOA compatibility.
evidence: Fixture BOM includes generated/unqualified rows; library lookup is NOT_EVALUATED; 6 footprint-mismatch warnings.
impact: Parts can be numerically plausible yet physically unsuitable or connected to the wrong package pads.
fix: Require exact MPN/order code, datasheet revision, conditions, model license/version/hash and reviewed pin/footprint mapping; retain unresolved items explicitly.
acceptance: A real representative buck BOM resolves every populated footprint/model/pin map; missing model or rating blocks the affected verification claim.

description: Specification coverage is narrower than the complete engineering brief
root_cause: Typed Specification lacks first-class efficiency, ripple/regulation, mechanical, cooling, EMI, reliability, cost and manufacturing fields; generic requirement text can hold them but not automatically evaluate them.
evidence: models.Specification; engineering_records.models.Requirement; fixture persisted two measurable requirements only.
impact: Declared requirements may remain disconnected from measurable tests or authoritative constraints.
fix: Define the minimum first-release requirement schema and explicit requirement-to-test links; retain sources, units, ranges, conflicts and accepted exclusions.
acceptance: Completeness and conflict tests cover all chosen fixture requirements; changed requirements invalidate affected calculations/reviews; every requirement has an explicit verification method and status.

description: Waveform windows and numerical summaries are inconsistent
root_cause: Runner previews only the first 200 points; averages are sample-weighted on adaptive time; RPC ignores start/limit.
evidence: independent-waveform-check.json: 25,774 points / 5 ms versus 30 us preview; 4.8448 V sample mean versus 4.85705 V time-weighted; RPC limit 5 returns 1,031.
impact: Startup previews can be mistaken for steady state; integration accuracy and API bounds are not reliable.
fix: Use a declared settling/measurement window, time-weighted integration or named native measurements, full-domain decimation and enforced pagination/trace validation.
acceptance: Independent nonuniform-time vectors and real raw files agree within declared tolerance; zero tolerance remains zero; requested limits and windows are honored and reflected in reports.

description: Magnetic loss coefficient units differ across calculators
root_cause: One path interprets frequency in Hz, another uses kHz and an extra 1000 factor; coefficient metadata is not dimensioned.
evidence: engineering-counterexamples.json; intelligence/calculations.py and integrations/calculations/power_losses.py.
impact: Identically named coefficient inputs can imply orders-of-magnitude different losses.
fix: Declare coefficient units, fit frequency/flux/temperature/waveform domain and source data. Normalize only with explicit conversions and independent reference cases.
acceptance: All exposed paths reproduce the same qualified material loss benchmark and reject coefficients outside their declared units/domain.

description: Thermal and trace-width labels overstate qualification
root_cause: New models use defaults and empirical cooling factors; the trace equation is labeled IPC-2152 although the exposed power-law coefficients are associated with IPC-2221 references.
evidence: thermal_sizing.py; TI SNVA766; controller requires explicit values on its route, but lower-level defaults still exist.
impact: A formula evaluation or PASS_DERATED label can be mistaken for qualified thermal/current capability.
fix: Review units, thermal network and temperature-limit policy, remove unsupported normative labels, and validate against independently documented component and board examples.
acceptance: Analytical resistor-network checks plus independent device/heatsink and board-stackup cases; unknown airflow/contact/stackup remains unqualified.

description: Duplicate Copper insulation rules undermine fail-closed core behavior
root_cause: Copper creepage helper returns a numerical rule while ignoring material_group and accepting negative voltage by abs().
evidence: boundary-results.json: I/II/IIIa/IIIb all return 5 mm at 230 V; negative voltage accepted.
impact: Users can obtain confident distances through a second path even though the core reports no qualified ruleset.
fix: Use one typed applicability service; refuse unsupported contexts, preserve NOT_EVALUATED and separate slot geometry operations from safety approval.
acceptance: Every UI/CLI/MCP/native adapter path shares identical context and unsupported-case behavior; no material/default/slot shortcut grants compliance.

description: FEMM excitation and magnetic benchmarks remain incomplete
root_cause: Generator and IR expose geometry/current fields, but defaults, material names, boundary and domain fidelity need independent qualification.
evidence: femm_generator.py; excited FEMM acceptance skip in prior runs; this nonisolated buck has no magnetic FEMM model.
impact: A successful mesh/solver or near-zero B field is not validated transformer behavior.
fix: Use a bounded excited reference with known ampere-turns, material, mesh convergence and analytical/integral comparison; document 2D/harmonic limits.
acceptance: Nonzero excitation gives reproducible physically meaningful B/L; unexcited/missing-material/invalid-boundary cases cannot imply magnetic acceptance.

description: Converter control and protection coverage is incomplete
root_cause: Native solver capabilities do not equal implemented feedback compensation, loop/FRA, startup/fault, short-circuit, inrush and thermal-protection workflows.
evidence: No qualified complete loop/protection workflow was demonstrated; fixture used fixed switching assumptions.
impact: Nominal steady-state output does not establish line/load regulation or safe fault response.
fix: Bound the first supported converter family and add existing-native-tool procedures/models for control, startup, sweeps and faults, with explicit external review.
acceptance: Deliver stable gain/phase evidence, line/load/startup/fault cases and requirements links; unsupported protections remain explicit.

description: Topology names exceed demonstrated topology readiness
root_cause: Buck, boost, flyback, push-pull, LLC and phase-shifted full-bridge builders exist; no comprehensive per-topology benchmark establishes correctness.
evidence: synthesis.py and Copper bridge tests; only buck executed end-to-end here.
impact: Heuristic efficiency/scores and fixed design margins may be interpreted as validated topology selection.
fix: Publish an applicability matrix and qualify topology-specific equations, circuit graphs and native simulations incrementally. Keep other topologies unavailable or explicitly experimental.
acceptance: Each supported topology has explicit domain, independent numeric and graph tests, real-model simulation and known negative cases.

description: Power PCB generation/routing is not an engineering layout verification
root_cause: Generic pad shapes differ from referenced footprints; slot insertion is triggered by a VOUT net name, even in a nonisolated buck. Routing success is true when any track is added.
evidence: drc-before/after.json; board-3d.png; boundary-results.json; kicad_pcb_generator.py has_hv condition.
impact: Real native copper can still violate board edges, footprints, power-loop, thermal and isolation constraints.
fix: Use authoritative library footprints; explicit board/layout constraints and topology domains; require zero unresolved connections and configured critical DRC errors before a ready claim.
acceptance: Fixture has zero critical DRC/footprint mismatches, correct net graph and acceptable reviewed loops/returns; nonisolated fixture gets no invented HV slot.

description: 3D rendering is not mechanical verification
root_cause: PNG and STEP are generated, but no enclosure/heatsink/connector/height/clearance collision acceptance was demonstrated.
evidence: board-3d.png and board.step generated; displayed model coverage is incomplete.
modules: Copper render; CAD preview; FreeCAD adapter
impact: A visually plausible assembly does not prove mechanical fit or accessibility.
fix: Track model coverage and validate explicit envelope/collision/height constraints with native CAD review.
acceptance: Known-collision and known-clearance fixtures are detected; every missing 3D model is listed rather than omitted from acceptance.

description: EMI/EMC evidence chain needs external verification
root_cause: No conducted/radiated measurement or qualified converter-specific EMI filter validation was executed.
evidence: Native fixture is idealized; workflow/document templates are not lab results.
impact: No credible EMC or final thermal qualification follows from nominal simulated waveforms.
fix: Prepare revision-linked external test methods, limits, instrumentation and result ingestion with honest evidence classes.
effort: 3-5 engineer-days software plus external lab schedule
acceptance: Real independently supplied measurement files are linked and reviewed; absent tests never become simulated/measured equivalents.

description: Measurement recording does not establish physical-test authenticity
root_cause: MeasurementRecord stores instruments/calibration/operator and values, but the application cannot establish their real-world origin.
evidence: measurements/models.py; manual prototype plan fixture was not executed.
impact: Software can store a measurement-shaped record without proving physical hardware passed.
fix: Define an external human procedure/evidence policy and requirement links; retain raw originals, failures, revisions and explicit simulated/calculated/measured distinctions.
acceptance: No physical stage completes from simulation-only records; genuine measured evidence must meet the declared method and be independently reviewed.

description: Manual review is attribution, not a human-only security boundary
root_cause: Names/comments and digests are intentionally accepted without identity/qualification proof; same-user software can call local APIs.
evidence: engineering_reviews.service manual mode; identity_authenticated=false; no approval tool in observed 62-tool MCP inventory.
impact: The platform cannot guarantee an AI agent cannot mimic a human reviewer name.
fix: Preserve the requested lightweight workflow, document its trust boundary, exclude review decisions from agent transports, and require actual external human review/release authority.
acceptance: Automated interfaces cannot present declared attribution as authenticated or laboratory-qualified approval; safety decisions remain visibly human-supplied and context-bound.

description: Copper and new calculations lack full canonical agent parity
root_cause: Copper runs via embedded registry and desktop methods; observed Mendex MCP has no Copper routing/render/export tools. New thermal controller calculations and the four-kind persisted record schema differ.
evidence: tool-names.json: 62 tools, no Copper-specific tools; CalculationWrite literal four versus seven controller calculators.
impact: Agent and UI flows can have different validation, traceability and capabilities.
fix: Expose narrowly typed operations through the existing shared core/registry and align calculator capability records, without creating a second engine.
acceptance: Same disposable operation via UI/core/CLI/MCP yields equivalent validation, revision links and evidence metadata.

description: Release-grade regression and test isolation are not established
root_cause: Some new tests open the live root and hardcoded project; full Qt run ended in an access violation; broad audit tests include a failure and slow PDF paths.
evidence: test_emc100_lifecycle_progression.py; inherited priority1 regression log; audit safe-pytest artifacts.
modules: tests; report/PDF subprocess boundaries; Qt lifetime management
impact: Tests can depend on workstation/project state and cannot currently establish a repeatable release baseline.
fix: Move all live-coupled tests to explicit opt-in checks, use disposable roots and controlled process lifetimes, and preserve clean exit-code checks.
acceptance: Fresh bounded isolated regression exits zero twice; no live root access or background GUI creation; process teardown and native timeouts are tested.

description: Standalone desktop and clean-install acceptance are blocked
root_cause: Web assets build but native Cargo check cannot run with the configured toolchain; packaged Python/backend/dependency installation has not been demonstrated.
evidence: cargo.log; frontend build; Tauri config and Rust backend resolution.
impact: Source development mode is not a portable installed engineering application.
fix: Repair existing native build/packaging and perform manual clean-Windows install, backend discovery, recovery/uninstall acceptance; do not add CI/CD or deployments.
acceptance: Installed app runs without checkout/venv assumptions and preserves data through restart/recovery; no missing-runtime silent fallback.

description: Rendered interactive workflow acceptance is unavailable
root_cause: The supported browser connection exposes no sessions; source/server-render or native CLI output does not prove UI behavior.
evidence: Browser bootstrap iab unavailable and browser list empty; no screenshots of the live end-to-end workflow were asserted.
impact: Navigation, latency, errors and file-opening interactions remain unverified.
fix: Run the documented open-Studio acceptance on a supported session using the disposable fixture and independently inspect every displayed status/result.
acceptance: Screens show the actual revision, failures and waveform domain; stale/out-of-order/error states and native opens are observed.

description: Lifecycle completion is process tracking, not comprehensive discipline acceptance
root_cause: Default post-initialization stages principally require a named validation record plus review; documentation depends on verification, not physical-testing completion.
evidence: engineering-lifecycle.json; fixture starts calculations while requirements is in progress; no engineering stages were approved.
impact: A recorded stage/document milestone cannot be equated with an electrically validated manufactured product.
fix: Define measurable acceptance bundles for the bounded first-release workflow and distinguish draft documentation from an externally authorized final release package.
acceptance: Negative evidence/missing physical tests cannot produce a final-ready claim; declared exemptions stay explicit with downstream restrictions.

description: Long native operations bypass consistent job/retry handling
root_cause: Direct desktop CAD/routing/render/report calls can exceed UI transport deadlines and lack the same operation receipts as core record writes.
evidence: Direct adapter calls and automatic PDF/render-on-read source; routing and report steps execute synchronously.
modules: desktop/service.py; vite bridge; job service; dossier generator
impact: A timeout can look like failure after a mutation already happened, encouraging duplicate actions.
fix: Reuse the existing job service for bounded native operations, retain idempotency/context receipts and show uncertain outcomes without automatic mutation replay.
acceptance: Timeout/retry/cancellation scenarios preserve one identifiable outcome and every prior snapshot; UI observes completion without guessing.
